description: Managed here: GitHub Actions and the three analyzer packages. Actions are pinned to a major tag, so an update is a new major and merges itself once the build and the integration test are green; for the analyzers only a patch does, since a new rule set turns warnings into a failing build.

Deliberately not managed: Jellyfin.Controller and Jellyfin.Model. They pin which server ABI the plugin is built against, not a library to keep current, and they only move together with targetAbi in build.yaml. The Docker images in test/run.sh are pinned to the same release and are likewise moved by hand.

packageRules.description: Mirrors the server release, see build.yaml. Last, so the rules above cannot re-enable it.
